lede: Texas State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +3.5 against +2.4, a 1.1-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Texas State +6.7 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with North Texas winning 67% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is special teams, where North Texas leads Texas State by 49 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 80% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
